title: Pumpkin seed flour (a cold-pressed by-product): characterization and rheological assessment in gluten-free bread premixes
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00268K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Juan José Burbano, Manuel Rojas, Marina Fernández Bravo, Julio Vidaurre-Ruiz, Ritva Repo Carrasco Valencia, María Jimena Correa
Pumpkin seed flour (PSF) showed high nutritional value, oxidative stability, and techno-functionality. When used to supplement rice flour, PSF improved the pasting properties and rheological quality of gluten-free premixes.
